description: Cooper University Health Care residents and fellows can get a Guardian GSI disability policy with no medical underwriting. What the program includes, and why to get it before applying anywhere else.
lede: Residents and fellows at Cooper University Health Care can get a Guardian guaranteed standard issue (GSI) disability policy with no medical underwriting. Jay Weinberg is the broker named on Cooper's GSI program flyer.
short: Yes. Cooper's residents and fellows are eligible for a Guardian GSI policy: no health questions, true own-occupation coverage with medical specialty language, and the option to start small and increase later. Get it before you complete any other disability application.
facts: Residents and fellows at Cooper University Health Care
Guardian (issued by Berkshire Life Insurance Company of America, a Guardian subsidiary)
None. Guaranteed standard issue, no medical underwriting
True own occupation to age 67, with medical specialty language
Up to $7,500, subject to new-professional limits, or up to $15,000 with financial underwriting
Future Increase Option rider: start with a smaller benefit and add coverage later, up to $15,000 total
Enhanced Partial Benefit rider: triggered by a 15% loss of income, or of time or duties
facts_note: From Cooper's GSI program flyer (2023). Terms can change, and optional riders cost extra. Jay confirms the current offer before you apply.
